limitations: Identifies total ideal weight, not full maximizing-weight uniqueness
Non-Desarguesian and multiple-line deletions not studied
Supplementary computation is finite and not independent validation
scientific_integrity: Exact finite-dimensional trace-norm derivation and asymptotic proof; computational cases are supplementary. All optimizing ideal-column totals are identified, not necessarily every individual weight. Older equivalent graph formulations remain a literature risk.
title: Sharp Schur norm and weight rigidity after deleting one projective-plane line
